title: Changing a Light Bulb 1000' Above Los Angeles
description:
Radio tower technicians climb the massive tower beside the Hollywood Sign, where they replace a critical beacon light at the very top. Hundreds of feet above the ground, every step matters, and safety is always on their minds.

Behind the scenes, these towers power the radio network that police, firefighters, and emergency crews depend on every day. This system runs 24/7, helping teams stay connected when seconds count. The radios they use are a lifeline, and keeping them working is a matter of life and death.

Most people never think about what happens on these towers. But through wind, weather, and constant wear, crews climb, repair, and maintain the equipment that keeps the City of Los Angeles moving. It’s demanding, high-risk work that quietly keeps everyone safe.
